text: {"label":"Functional Behavior Assessment Methods and Practice","definition":"Research and discussion on how functional behavior assessments are designed, compared, validated, taught and implemented, including practical functional assessment models, brief and indirect methods, school-based use, and practitioner training.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Covers functional assessment as a whole process and its uptake in practice, unlike the neighbour on experimental functional analysis procedures, broad problem-behavior treatment advances, or clinical behavior analysis and psychotherapy."}
